headline: EV physics meets arcade survival in 1 HTML file
text:
A drift game where your battery is your health bar & regen braking keeps you alive.

Real weight-transfer physics in a single HTML file—no downloads, instant 0.1s load:
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #indiedev #webdev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second seamless gameplay GIF showing a tight weight-transfer slide around oncoming traffic, cutting to a green glow on the HUD as regen braking kicks in.
